mainEntity.name: How accurate is this compared to a lab VO2 max test?

acceptedAnswer.text: Field and non-exercise formulas are reasonable estimates but less precise than a supervised lab test with breathing gas analysis. They're most useful for tracking your own changes over time, using the same method each time.

mainEntity.name: When should I measure my resting heart rate?

acceptedAnswer.text: First thing in the morning before getting out of bed gives the most consistent reading. Readings taken later in the day, after caffeine, activity or stress, tend to run higher.

If you can't do a hard effort, use the resting heart rate or Rockport walk test. If you run regularly, the Cooper 12-minute or 1.5-mile run test usually gives a better estimate because it measures actual performance.
